messages:
cust-sysops: Hi team — we have a SIG/CAIQ deadline next Tue. Need audit log samples + KMS/HSM attestation for data-at-rest. We're seeing intermittent 401s when exporting logs, and one spike of token auth failures yesterday. Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and if we can get a short extension? cc: @priya_cs
priya_cs: Thanks — can you paste the error samples (request ids) and approximate times? We'll try to reproduce. Also: do you need exports for the last 90 days or a specific window?
alex_eng: Looping in eng. Can you share the `x-request-id` header or the full curl that failed? If you still have the 401 response body paste that. Common culprits: expired API key, token rotation race, or client clock skew. Quick repro command to try:```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: your-id" "https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/logs/export"
```
cust-sysops: Sample times: 2026-03-07 14:02 UTC, 2026-03-08 03:19 UTC. Request ids: rq_8a2f, rq_9b3c. Need last 60 days. Also need proof of KMS key rotation policy & HSM attestation.
alex_eng: Thanks — I pulled rq_8a2f and rq_9b3c from server logs. rq_8a2f => 401 `token_invalid` with issuer mismatch; rq_9b3c => 401 with `token_expired` + small client clock skew (~1m20s). If you can confirm `date -u` on the client and paste the 401 response bodies (headers only if you prefer) that helps. We'll also prepare a signed audit export.
cust-sysops: Pasted response for rq_9b3c: {"error":"invalid_token","message":"token expired"} — token was rotated yesterday; not sure why some succeeded and others failed.
priya_cs: Opening internal ticket and triage. @alex_eng @maria_sec can you take the two request ids and confirm root cause? Customer also asked for the attestation doc and KMS export.
maria_sec: We can provide the HSM attestation PDF and key-rotation policy. I'll upload the latest attestation to the evidence folder. Timeline: I can get HSM attestation + rotation policy to you by EOD tomorrow. For the SIG CAIQ, we can supply signed audit log exports but need legal signoff for third-party transfer — will confirm.
alex_eng: Action items: (1) Eng will reproduce the export flow and provide the exact command used; (2) produce a redacted audit export (PII/IP redaction) and a signed copy; (3) confirm root cause for the 401s. Repro command we ran internally: `python tools/export_logs.py --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-03-08 --signed --key-id=arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd --redact-ip` — we'll include a README in the export.
priya_cs: We offered the customer a 3-day extension on the SIG due date while we gather artifacts. They accepted. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Export prepared: https://redwood.example.com/exports/abc123 (expires in 7 days). Contents: signed-audit-log-2026-01-01_to_2026-03-08.tar.gz, sha256sum.txt, hsm-attestation.pdf.
cust-sysops: Downloading now. Quick Q: can we get the export with IP-level anonymization redacted? Some entries are PII. Also can you include the exact server-side command and any env vars you used so we can reproduce locally?
alex_eng: Yes — we'll produce a redacted export (redacted-ip) and include a README with the exact server command, env vars, and the verification steps (how to validate the signature + sha256). We'll also add the minimal steps to reproduce the 401 locally (how to set up token rotation to recreate the race).
maria_sec: HSM attestation uploaded to the evidence folder and shared link via the export. Legal approved a limited transfer for SIG use only; chain of custody doc included.
cust-sysops: Appreciate it. We'll review and confirm. Please keep this thread updated if anything else changes. — Sarah (cust-sysops)
